rationale: The landing md/repo/renderer-contracts.md#claim-meta.syntax.heap.constructors directly introduces Diagram node constructors. The diagram vocabulary is introduced here: graph facts, nodes and slots each have clear named passages. Aliases, initial empty slots and the boundary from language semantics are stated locally. No language formula is used. α or edge-style examples elsewhere are diagram identifiers, while this unit defines the available fact constructors. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
